result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): A makes booking a first session the clear main action. It shows real wheel slots with availability badges and uses concrete studio details, like aprons by the sink and the walkthrough before loading the kiln. Its getting-started steps also show what happens after booking, though the credits panel adds a bit of secondary detail. B is clean and focused, but it splits the first step into two equal choices with no clear button and gives no preview of what comes after. Most of its screen is empty, so it looks unfinished. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): B leads with a clear 'Book your first session' panel that shows real wheel and kiln slot times, adds reassuring pottery-specific text (aprons, tools, studio monitor), and includes a 'what happens next' checklist, so the first action feels low-risk. It does add a studio credits panel that spreads attention a little. A is focused and clean, but it shows only two plain choice cards, doesn't preview what booking looks like, and leaves most of the screen empty.
